fi-sargocentron-diadema.title: Crown Squirrelfish
fi-sargocentron-diadema.summary: A red squirrelfish with silver-white stripes from Indo-Pacific reefs. It hides under ledges by day and comes out to feed at night.
rows: About 6 in (Saltwaterfish.com adult size); wild record 17 cm (6.7 in) TL (FishBase)
Carnivore: crustaceans, worms and other meaty foods
Indo-Pacific: Red Sea and East Africa to the Hawaiian and Pitcairn islands, north to the Ryukyu and Ogasawara islands, south to northern Australia and Lord Howe Island
notes: Corals are safe, but small crustaceans and small fish can be eaten; keep with similar-sized tankmates.
warn: Has a venomous spine on its gill cover.
